<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="python-api">
<h1>Python API</h1>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.api</span></code> is Readio’s supported, synchronous Python application boundary. Import application objects and stable request/result types from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.api</span></code>. Modules outside that namespace are implementation details unless explicitly documented as an extension contract.</p>
<p>Importing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.api</span></code> does not import CLI adapters, optional engine runtimes, or Spotify integration code. Runtime integrations are loaded only by the operations that need them.
Both <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.cli</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.spotify_cli</span></code> are consumers of this application boundary. They may own argument parsing, prompts, terminal progress, human/JSON presentation, and process exit codes, but application and domain operations must go through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.api</span></code>. A regression test enforces that the CLIs do not import domain implementation modules directly.</p>
<p>The API does not depend on the CLI or TTSForge. It performs no printing, process exit, or implicit logging configuration. Calls block until their operation completes. Long-running services accept an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">on_event</span></code> callback; GUI and orchestration clients can run a synchronous call in their own worker.</p>
<section id="application-and-configuration">
<h2>Application and configuration</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Readio</span>

<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">()</span>  <span class="c1"># load the normal user configuration</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>For an isolated application or custom configuration, pass an immutable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReadioConfig</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">dataclasses</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">replace</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">default_config</span>

<span class="n">config</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">default_config</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">config</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">replace</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">config</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">paths</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">replace</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">paths</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;./output&quot;</span><span class="p">)),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Services are created lazily on first access: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.speech</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.projects</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.audiobooks</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.catalog</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.roles</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.ssmd</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.configuration</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.templates</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.ingest</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.diagnostics</span></code>. Persisted configuration changes do not mutate an existing application’s snapshot. Create a new <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Readio</span></code> instance to use the saved values.</p>
</section>
<section id="one-shot-speech">
<h2>One-shot speech</h2>
<p>Construct a typed request instead of passing CLI arguments. The same request can be planned without synthesis, rendered to a file, played, or sent to a caller-owned sink.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">json</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">InputRequest</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">OutputRequest</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">PlanRequest</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">SynthesisRequest</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">document_from_text</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">request</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">PlanRequest</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">operation</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;render&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="nb">input</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">InputRequest</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">document</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">document_from_text</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello from Readio.&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">requested_format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;text&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">synthesis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">SynthesisRequest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">OutputRequest</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">requested_format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;wav&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">requested_path</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;hello.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">speech</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">request</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># metadata resolution only, no TTS model/session</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dumps</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_dict</span><span class="p">(),</span> <span class="n">ensure_ascii</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ok</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">speech</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">render</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">request</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">write_manifest</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">output_path</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">document_from_file(path)</span></code> constructs an input document from a file. In auto mode, it calls the ssmdconvert integration and returns canonical SSMD for supported text, Markdown, HTML, PDF, DOCX, EPUB, and SSMD inputs. Choose <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">requested_format=&quot;markdown&quot;</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;ssmd&quot;</span></code> when a textual file’s format is known; explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">markdown</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ssmd</span></code> reads the file as text instead of invoking conversion. A successful bounded <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render()</span></code> owns its output file and sink. It returns a typed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">RenderResult</span></code>; when requested, the colocated render manifest is available as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result.manifest_path</span></code>.</p>
<p>For auto-converted sources, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">InputDocument.provenance</span></code> is an immutable public <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">DocumentProvenance</span></code> value containing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_format</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">media_type</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_name</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">converter</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">converter_version</span></code>, and converter <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">metadata</span></code>. Explicit text/Markdown/SSMD input does not claim conversion provenance.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SynthesisRequest.speed</span></code> is a finite positive engine synthesis multiplier and is not also applied as composition rate. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_level</span></code> accepts <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;off&quot;</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;calibrated&quot;</span></code>; both settings are passed through typed planning and are part of the effective speech identity. PocketSynth currently supports only speed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">1.0</span></code> and reports unsupported explicit values as a resolution error. Supertonic converts locale tags to the model’s base language, so <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en-us</span></code> resolves to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en</span></code>, and rejects unsupported bases.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render_live_to_file(lines,</span> <span class="pre">output,</span> <span class="pre">...)</span></code> consumes the caller-owned iterable without closing it, resolves the output format/path, creates and closes its own file sink, and atomically commits the file. Its <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">RenderResult</span></code> includes <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">output_path</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio_format</span></code>. Live support is declared by each adapter’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">capabilities().supports_live</span></code>; requesting live synthesis from an unsupported engine raises <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">InvalidRequestError</span></code> with code <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">speech.live_unsupported</span></code>.</p>
<p>For playback, call <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.speech.speak(request)</span></code>. It creates and closes the playback sink. For live text, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render_live(lines,</span> <span class="pre">sink,</span> <span class="pre">...)</span></code> consumes but does not close the caller’s iterable or sink. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">speak_live(lines,</span> <span class="pre">...)</span></code> owns playback. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render_to_sink(request,</span> <span class="pre">sink)</span></code> writes bounded output to a caller-owned <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudioSink</span></code> and leaves it open.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">speak()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">speak_live()</span></code> stream incrementally through Readio-owned playback and disable whole-program mastering. They preserve stateful composition semantics across segments; bounded <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render()</span></code> remains the full-document mastered path.</p>
<p>For PocketSynth, pass the registered bundle as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">model</span></code> and select exactly one of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice</span></code> (a predefined bundle voice), <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_file</span></code> (a local WAV), or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_prompt</span></code> (a managed Kyutai prompt). Engine-specific generation options use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">engine_options</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">request</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">PlanRequest</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">operation</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;render&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="nb">input</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">InputRequest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">document</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">document_from_text</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello.&quot;</span><span class="p">)),</span>
    <span class="n">synthesis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">SynthesisRequest</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">engine</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;pocket&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;BUNDLE_ID&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">voice_file</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;reference.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">engine_options</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;precision&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;fp32&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;temperature&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mf">0.6</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">OutputRequest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">requested_path</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;pocket.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">)),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The resolver records the reference WAV’s SHA-256 in the render target and excludes its local path from acoustic identity. For <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_prompt</span></code>, planning records the managed reference, source SHA-256, revision, and available provenance; rendering verifies prepared provenance and stores the prepared-audio fingerprint separately. Managed prompts are default synthesis voices, not role bindings.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">prompt_request</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">SynthesisRequest</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">engine</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;pocket&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;BUNDLE_ID&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">voice_prompt</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;kyutai-tts-voices:alba-mackenna/casual&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_file</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_prompt</span></code> are mutually exclusive. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_prompt</span></code> is Pocket-only; a non-Pocket request receives a planning diagnostic.</p>
<p>An <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudioSink</span></code> implements <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">write(audio,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate)</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">close()</span></code>. For example, an application can implement this protocol to stream chunks into its own audio pipeline. Do not pass a sink to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">json.dumps</span></code>; sinks are runtime resources, not result data.</p>
</section>
<section id="projects-and-audiobooks">
<h2>Projects and audiobooks</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.projects.create(source,</span> <span class="pre">output=...)</span></code> creates a persistent project and returns a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectRef</span></code>, the stable handle for later calls. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">open()</span></code> loads a project, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">find()</span></code> locates one if present, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">status()</span></code> returns typed stage status and next actions.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">CompositionOptions</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">ExportOptions</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">AUDIOBOOK_EXPORT_FORMAT</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">SUPPORTED_AUDIOBOOK_FORMATS</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">AudiobookExportOptions</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">ProjectBuildRequest</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">project</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;article.md&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;article.readio&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">synthesis</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">synthesize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">composition</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">compose</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">CompositionOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_lufs</span><span class="o">=-</span><span class="mf">18.0</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">exported</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">export</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ExportOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;mp3&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="c1"># Or incrementally build through a target stage. Existing reusable work is kept.</span>
<span class="n">build</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">build</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ProjectBuildRequest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;export&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectBuildRequest</span></code> carries the stage target, selection, synthesis settings, composition options, and export options. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreviewRequest</span></code> controls a selection and temporary output for a preview. Every lifecycle method returns a typed result, and mutating operations accept <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">on_event</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">CompositionOptions.mastering</span></code> selects <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spoken-word</span></code> by default (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-16</span> <span class="pre">LUFS/-1</span> <span class="pre">dBTP</span></code>); the other profiles are <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spoken-word-dual-mono</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-19/-1</span></code>), <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">broadcast-ebu</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-23/-1</span></code>), <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">peak-safe</span></code> (no LUFS target, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-1</span> <span class="pre">dBTP</span></code>), and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">off</span></code> (no target or ceiling). <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">target_lufs</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">true_peak_ceiling_dbtp</span></code> override profile values when non-<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> inherits. For example, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">CompositionOptions(mastering=&quot;broadcast-ebu&quot;,</span> <span class="pre">target_lufs=-21.0)</span></code> keeps the EBU true-peak ceiling and uses a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-21</span> <span class="pre">LUFS</span></code> target.</p>
<p>Persist desired pipeline choices through <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectService</span></code> before running the stages. Settings writes use the project manifest’s atomic update path, preserve schema-3 project settings and unrelated namespaces, and do not open a TTS session. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectSettingsPatch</span></code> uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UNSET</span></code> to leave a section unchanged, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> to clear it, and a concrete immutable value to replace it:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">CompositionOptions</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">ExportOptions</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">ProjectSettings</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">ProjectSettingsPatch</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">ProjectSynthesisSettings</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">UNSET</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">project</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;article.readio&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">configure</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">project</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">ProjectSettings</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">synthesis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">ProjectSynthesisSettings</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">engine</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;piper&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en_US-amy-medium&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">composition</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">CompositionOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_lufs</span><span class="o">=-</span><span class="mf">18.0</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">export</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">ExportOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;mp3&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;output/article.mp3&quot;</span><span class="p">)),</span>
    <span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">update_settings</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ProjectSettingsPatch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">composition</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">export</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">UNSET</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">configure()</span></code> replaces supported sections while retaining <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">settings.ssmd</span></code> and unknown namespaces. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">update_settings()</span></code> patches sections independently. Relative paths resolve from the project root. Saved synthesis settings are applied before global and engine defaults; explicit invocation requests override saved values without persisting those overrides. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">force</span></code> and synthesis <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">refresh</span></code> remain invocation-only.</p>
<p>Requestless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">synthesize()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compose()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">export()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build()</span></code> use saved settings. Status compares built provenance to desired settings: synthesis changes invalidate downstream stages, composition changes invalidate composition/output, and export changes invalidate output only. Caches and previous outputs remain available.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectCompositionResult.loudness</span></code> is a typed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LoudnessSummary</span></code> with before/after integrated LUFS, sample peak and true peak, requested/applied gain, target status, warning, and analysis/gain/post-gain metric timings. The mastering operation is transparent constant gain: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reduce_gain</span></code> may stop short of the LUFS target to honor the true-peak ceiling; this is not a true-peak limiter or ACX compliance check.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.audiobooks.inspect(source)</span></code> accepts an EPUB file, an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ssmdbook</span></code> directory, or an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ssmdbook.zip</span></code> bundle and returns typed book metadata plus a chapter inventory. Each <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudiobookChapter.number</span></code> is its original 1-based source chapter number. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">create_project()</span></code> creates a chapter-scoped Readio project from the same source types; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">create_project_result()</span></code> additionally returns the selected source chapter numbers and scope IDs. Selectors address available source numbers and preserve source order, including when a bundle contains a non-contiguous subset. Readio stores each chapter as standalone editable SSMD and retains the input as provenance. Directory bundles are snapshotted as deterministic ZIP files. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.audiobooks.export(project,</span> <span class="pre">AudiobookExportOptions(...))</span></code> writes M4B with chapters using the audiobook-specific API. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SUPPORTED_AUDIOBOOK_FORMATS</span></code> contains <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">m4b</span></code>; it is intentionally not in generic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SUPPORTED_AUDIO_FORMATS</span></code>.
Unsupported document formats, missing converter adapters, conversion failures, invalid bundle sources, and invalid chapter selections are translated to Readio API errors with stable codes and the original source path where applicable. Common codes include <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">input.format_unsupported</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">input.converter_dependency_missing</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">input.conversion_failed</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">input.book_bundle_invalid</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">request.chapter_selection_invalid</span></code>.
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">describe_project(project)</span></code> describes an existing audiobook after reopening it. The immutable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudiobookProjectDescription</span></code> contains its <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectRef</span></code>, persisted source path, and persisted <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudiobookProjectChapter</span></code> values (chapter number, scope ID, title, and level). Readio loads the project and validates its kind; consumers do not need to inspect project files.
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">create_project(...,</span> <span class="pre">settings=ProjectSettings(audiobook_export=...))</span></code> can save output, metadata, cover, and bitrate defaults at creation time. Omitted export options use those values; explicitly supplied non-<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> values override them for one invocation without mutating the manifest. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.audiobooks.build(project)</span></code> runs the ordinary plan, synthesis, and composition services before M4B export. It respects the project’s stored chapter scope and returns an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudiobookExportResult</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.projects.resolve_synthesis(project,</span> <span class="pre">request=None,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">voice_bindings=None,</span> <span class="pre">use_saved_settings=True)</span></code> returns a typed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SynthesisResolution</span></code> with effective engine, language, voice, model, model source, quality, speed, unit, pause mode, voice level, planning settings, and pronunciation/resource policies: lexicons, G2P fallback, lexicon data policy, language-detection mode and languages, and experimental-option permission. It uses the same project synthesis resolver as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">synthesize()</span></code>: fatal choices raise public API errors, and non-fatal resolver diagnostics are returned on the result.
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">use_saved_settings=True</span></code> preserves saved project synthesis precedence for existing callers. Set it to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">False</span></code> when a configuration editor or guided frontend is replacing saved engine, model, or voice choices. Fresh resolution ignores only persisted <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectSynthesisSettings</span></code>; request values, current Readio configuration and language defaults, and call-scoped <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_bindings</span></code> still participate. It does not change sparse request semantics or make incomplete Piper/Pocket selections valid. Both modes remain non-rendering and non-mutating and perform no acoustic inference.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lexicons</span></code> preserves three states: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> means automatic or inherited behavior, an empty tuple means static lexicon layers were explicitly disabled, and a non-empty tuple lists selected layers. These fields expose resolved request/profile values; preflight does not materialize backend runtime defaults that were not resolved.</p>
<p>Resolution is read-only and intended for preflight, validation, and UI display. It does not render audio, open an engine session, activate a profile, or mutate project configuration, profile files, manifests, caches, audio, role bindings, or persistent synthesis/build state. It reports the same effective selection semantics used by actual project synthesis.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">SynthesisRequest</span>

<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">project</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;novel.readio&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">book</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">audiobooks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">describe_project</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">chapter</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">book</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">chapters</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chapter</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">number</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chapter</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chapter</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">scope_id</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">request</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">SynthesisRequest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;af_heart&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">speed</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">resolved</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">resolve_synthesis</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">request</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">resolved</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">engine</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">voice</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">resolved</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">model</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">model_source</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">quality</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">book</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;novel.readio&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">m4b</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">audiobooks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">export</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">book</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">AudiobookExportOptions</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="nb">format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">AUDIOBOOK_EXPORT_FORMAT</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">cover</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;cover.jpg&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>  <span class="c1"># optional explicit JPEG/PNG</span>
        <span class="n">bitrate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;96k&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">on_event</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">handle_event</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Title and author default from the project’s persisted book metadata and can be overridden. The audiobook M4B AAC bitrate defaults to 192k; generic M4A also defaults to 192k and generic Opus to 96k. These are Readio defaults, not a claim of TTSForge default parity. M4B identity includes the master/timeline, resolved metadata, explicit cover hash, and effective bitrate. Automatic source cover extraction is not part of the current ssmdconvert integration; pass an explicit JPEG/PNG cover.</p>
</section>
<section id="discovery-and-roles">
<h2>Discovery and roles</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.catalog.engines()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">targets()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">models()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voices()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_prompts()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lexicons()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio_formats()</span></code> expose typed discovery data. Listing methods such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">models_listing()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voices_listing()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_prompts_listing()</span></code> wrap entries with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">CatalogDiscovery</span></code> metadata, including source, cache fallback, offline, and refresh state. Pass <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">DiscoveryOptions(offline=True)</span></code> to use cached metadata without a network refresh.
Canonical engine IDs are <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kokoro</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">piper</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pocket</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">supertonic</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kitten</span></code>; upstream names such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pykokoro</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pipersynth</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">supertonicsynth</span></code> are accepted only as input aliases where supported. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.catalog.normalize_engine()</span></code> returns canonical IDs. Lexicon queries are filtered through engine capabilities. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voices</span> <span class="pre">list</span></code> CLI treats a registered engine name supplied to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--model</span></code> as an engine filter when <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--engine</span></code> is omitted.
Voice references use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SYSTEM:TARGET[/VOICE]</span></code>, for example <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kokoro:v1.0/af_heart</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">piper:en_US-amy-medium</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pocket:english_2026-04/alba</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">supertonic:supertonic-3/F1</span></code>. Public voice records expose <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ref</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">target_id</span></code>, and public engine names. Metadata filtering uses descriptive language, locale, and gender fields and does not affect identity. Pocket generic language <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en</span></code> matches a specific <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en-US</span></code> query, while an explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en-GB</span></code> locale does not; generic metadata is not assigned unsupported regional specificity.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">DiscoveryOptions</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">VoiceQuery</span>

<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">listing</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">catalog</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">voices_listing</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">VoiceQuery</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">discovery</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">DiscoveryOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">offline</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">voice</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">listing</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ref</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Pocket prompt discovery is a separate catalog operation because prompts are managed reference-audio assets, not target-bound <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">VoiceInfo</span></code> entries. It returns catalog metadata without opening a Pocket model or fetching prompt WAV files.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">DiscoveryOptions</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">VoicePromptQuery</span>

<span class="n">prompts</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">catalog</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">voice_prompts</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">VoicePromptQuery</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">engine</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;pocket&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">dataset</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;alba&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">variant</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;casual&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">discovery</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">DiscoveryOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">offline</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">prompt</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">prompts</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">prompt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ref</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">prompt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sha256</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">prompt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">source_revision</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">prompt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">license</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Catalogs also provide singular lookups and semantic voice-reference resolution. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.roles</span></code> lists and mutates global role bindings and inspects, binds, or unbinds project-local roles. New bindings resolve to public <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">VoiceTarget</span></code> values containing canonical <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">engine</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice</span></code>, and optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">target_id</span></code>. Selector provenance is not part of role identity or serialization. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">RoleBinding.target</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectRole.effective_target</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectRole.project_target</span></code> expose these values. Role JSON uses engine-qualified targets and does not include provider output fields; project inspection reports its selected <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">engine</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> when no single engine applies.</p>
<p>Bind mixed-engine roles through the same API used by the CLI:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Readio</span>

<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">project</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">projects</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;episode.readio&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">roles</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">bind_project</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;host&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;kokoro:v1.0/af_sarah&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">roles</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">bind_project</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;guest&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;piper:en_US-amy-medium&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">inspection</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">roles</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">inspect_project</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">project</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">role</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">inspection</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">roles</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">target</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">role</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">effective_target</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">target</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">role</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">role</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">target</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">engine</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">target</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">voice</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">bind_global(role,</span> <span class="pre">voice,</span> <span class="pre">engine=...)</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">bind_project(project,</span> <span class="pre">role,</span> <span class="pre">voice,</span> <span class="pre">engine=...)</span></code> accept semantic references and context-resolved native voice IDs; pass an explicit engine when a native ID cannot be inferred. Role DTOs expose engine-qualified <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">VoiceTarget</span></code> values with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">engine</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice</span></code>, and optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">target_id</span></code>; provider selector arguments and derived-provider output fields are not part of the v0.4 role API. Global and project settings use schema 3. Migrate v0.3 data explicitly with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio</span> <span class="pre">config</span> <span class="pre">migrate</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio</span> <span class="pre">project</span> <span class="pre">migrate</span> <span class="pre">PROJECT</span></code>; normal runtime code does not read legacy provider-keyed role maps. SSMD <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_bindings</span></code> syntax remains unchanged. Global configuration mutations persist; create a new <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Readio</span></code> instance to use the saved configuration snapshot.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unbind_project_result(project,</span> <span class="pre">role)</span></code> returns a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProjectRoleMutationResult</span></code> with the removed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">previous_project_binding</span></code>, resulting <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">project_binding</span></code>, newly effective target and voice, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">origin</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">status</span></code>. It avoids reopening the project just to inspect the state transition. The original <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unbind_project()</span></code> remains available and continues returning <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> for API-v1 compatibility.</p>
</section>
<section id="ssmd-configuration-templates-and-ingest">
<h2>SSMD, configuration, templates, and ingest</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.ssmd.check()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">analyze()</span></code> provide non-raising inspection of document and voice bindings. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.ssmd.validate()</span></code> returns the same typed check result but raises the public <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">VoiceResolutionError</span></code> when voice references remain unresolved. This lets interactive clients inspect with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">check()</span></code>, collect bindings, then call <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate()</span></code> without reconstructing domain errors. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">materialize_bindings()</span></code> writes an explicitly requested bound copy; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">roundtrip_check()</span></code> provides strict authoring validation.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.configuration</span></code> loads, validates, and atomically saves <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReadioConfig</span></code>, sets dotted values, and manages language profiles/defaults. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.templates</span></code> lists, reads, adds, removes, resets, seeds, and validates templates. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.ingest.create()</span></code> creates an ingest file; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">list()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">directory</span></code> inspect the configured location. Read-only methods do not create storage directories.</p>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LanguageProfilePatch</span></code> with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.configuration.update_language_profile(language,</span> <span class="pre">patch)</span></code> for partial updates. Omitted fields use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UNSET</span></code> and remain unchanged. Explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> clears nullable settings; for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lexicons</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> selects automatic lexicons while an empty tuple disables lexicon layers. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">allow_experimental=False</span></code> is an explicit update. The method merges against the latest persisted profile and does not mutate the current <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Readio.config</span></code> snapshot.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">LanguageProfilePatch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Readio</span>

<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">configuration</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">update_language_profile</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">LanguageProfilePatch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lexicons</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">allow_experimental</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="diagnostics">
<h2>Diagnostics</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">app.diagnostics.run()</span></code> returns a typed, local diagnostics report. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">engines()</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio_formats()</span></code> expose the corresponding typed diagnostic collections. Diagnostics are read-only and do not authenticate with Spotify or inspect credential files.</p>
</section>
<section id="engine-extensions">
<h2>Engine extensions</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">EngineAdapter</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">EngineSession</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">EngineCapabilities</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">RequestMeasure</span></code> are public extension contracts in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.api</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.api.extensions</span></code>. Implement the documented protocol and register an adapter with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">register_engine(adapter)</span></code>. Each synthesis call is one exact Readio-shaped request: adapters must not select new text boundaries or invoke native convenience splitters. Readio uses optional measurement or typed too-long errors to fit an oversized request, subdivides exact text while respecting protected token and pronunciation ranges, then merges child audio and rebases timings. Adapters should declare only semantics they implement; unsupported explicit features fail with stable Readio errors before inference. Prefer <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">engine_options</span></code> on <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SynthesisRequest</span></code> for engine-specific settings.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">registered_engines()</span></code> reports registered identifiers. Engine identities and the documented protocol, not private registry modules, are the compatibility boundary.</p>
</section>
<section id="spotify-integration">
<h2>Spotify integration</h2>
<p>Spotify support is optional and is deliberately not imported by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">import</span> <span class="pre">readio.api</span></code>. Import the integration explicitly:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pathlib</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Path</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Readio</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api.integrations.spotify</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">SpotifyService</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">SpotifyUploadRequest</span>

<span class="n">app</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">spotify</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">SpotifyService</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">app</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">spotify</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">upload</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">SpotifyUploadRequest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_path</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Path</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;episode.mp3&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;Episode&quot;</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Live publishing uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SpotifyService.publish_live()</span></code> so the integration owns audio rendering, temporary output, and upload as one operation:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">OutputRequest</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">SynthesisRequest</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">readio.api.integrations.spotify</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">SpotifyLivePublishRequest</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">SpotifyService</span>

<span class="n">spotify</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">SpotifyService</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Readio</span><span class="p">())</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">spotify</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">publish_live</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">SpotifyLivePublishRequest</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">lines</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">iter</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello from a live source.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">,)),</span>
        <span class="n">output</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">OutputRequest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">requested_format</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;wav&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">synthesis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">SynthesisRequest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;Episode&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>When <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">requested_path</span></code> is omitted, live publishing uses a temporary audio file and removes it after upload or failure. An explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">OutputRequest.requested_path</span></code> is retained. The input iterable stays caller-owned. Unsupported engine capability is reported as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">speech.live_unsupported</span></code>; live publishing also exposes stable integration errors such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spotify.live_output_invalid</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spotify.audio_format_invalid</span></code>.</p>
<p>The integration delegates to the separately installed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">save-to-spotify</span></code> executable. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">shows()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">upload()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">publish()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">publish_live()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">publish_rendered()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">status()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">set_timeline()</span></code> return typed values. Readio does not read Spotify credential files or perform authentication.</p>
</section>
<section id="errors-events-and-serialization">
<h2>Errors, events, and serialization</h2>
<p>Expected public failures derive from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReadioError</span></code> and expose stable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">code</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">message</span></code>, optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_path</span></code>, and structured <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">details</span></code>. Catch the most specific API error when recovery depends on the failure category, or catch <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReadioError</span></code> at an application boundary.</p>
<p>Speech planning failures raise <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlanNotExecutableError</span></code> with the resolved <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span></code> and typed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">diagnostics</span></code>; output-related planning failures raise <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannedOutputError</span></code>, which remains an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">OutputError</span></code>. Both retain the serialized diagnostics in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">details</span></code> for compatibility. CLI clients can render <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">error.plan</span></code> directly without repeating the planning operation.</p>
<p>Pass an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">on_event</span></code> callback to long-running operations or to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Readio(on_event=...)</span></code>. Call-level events are delivered before the application-level handler. Events are immutable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReadioEvent</span></code> values with machine-readable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kind</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">operation</span></code>, stage/progress fields, and structured details. Handler exceptions are not swallowed.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">EventKind</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">EventStage</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ProgressKind</span></code> are public <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Literal</span></code> vocabularies. Event kinds distinguish operation/stage lifecycle from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">progress</span></code>; stages identify plan, synthesis, composition, export, output, readiness, render, or upload. Progress subtypes identify phase, unit, segment, or item transitions. Consumers should branch on these fields rather than human-readable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">message</span></code> text.</p>
<p>Public request and result objects are typed and immutable where applicable. Results intended for persistence or JSON output provide <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">to_dict()</span></code>. These mappings convert <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Path</span></code> objects to strings and nested tuples to JSON arrays; for example, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">json.dumps(result.to_dict())</span></code>. Do not serialize runtime resources such as an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudioSink</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="stability-and-ownership">
<h2>Stability and ownership</h2>
<p>Symbols documented here and in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.api</span></code> or its documented submodules, public request/result fields, error codes, event fields/kinds, extension protocols, method semantics, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">to_dict()</span></code> keys are the supported compatibility surface. CLI helpers, private names, internal stage dictionaries, project layout, and cache sidecars are not stable API.</p>
<p>Input iterables and caller-provided audio sinks remain caller-owned and are not closed by Readio. Readio closes playback sinks and file sinks that it creates. Separate <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Readio</span></code> instances can be used independently subject to the selected engine/runtime constraints. Mutations of the same project continue to use project locking; concurrent model sessions on one instance are not generally guaranteed.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
